_hresult////e6c 我们需要计算 \(f(1)\) 的产品，而不是在解决问题，所以我们正确理解我们的问题。

让我们假设 \(f(x)\) 是一个非常数多项式,形式需要找到满足给定方程 \(g(x-1)g(x)g(x+1)=[g(x)]^2+2013x\)的\(f(a)\)和\(g(b)\)的乘积。
```python
#Definition of g(x)
import sympy as sp
x = sp.symbols('x')
g = sp.Function('g')(x)

#Given equation
equation = g.subs(x, x-1)*g.subs(x, x)*g.subs(x, x+1) - (g.subs(x, x))**2 - 2013*x

#Solve for g(a) and g(b)
sol_g1 = sp.solve(equation.subs(x, 1), g)
sol_g2 = sp.solve(equation.subs(x, -1), g)

#Calculate the product
product = sol_g1[0] * sol_g2[0]
print(product)
```
This program solves the given equation for \(g(a)\) and \(g(b)\) and calculates their product.
